# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster virtual total recall of any conversation or writing he
encountered within a period of days equal to his level.
@@ 2
Detects “true evil” in an animate or inanimate target; caster can concentrate
on a 5' radius area each round.
@@ 3
As Detect Evil, except caster can detect curses.
@@ 4
As Detect Evil, except caster can detect extremes of emotion (e.g., hatred,
love, sadness, etc.). In addition, the caster learns which emotions the target
is feeling in extreme. If there are no extremes of emotion (i.e., only normal
feelings), this spell detects nothing.
@@ 5
Caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of any 1 “holy item” that is
not “of darkness” or “of evil”; will not give specific capabilities.
@@ 6
Caster can ascertain exact nature and type of poison; he can determine what
cure may be used, but does not receive the required tools or skills.
@@ 8
Caster can determine the nature and type of any 1 living target. He will not
be able to ascertain the target’s personal traits or capabilities, but will
know the normal abilities associated with the target’s species.
@@ 10
Caster can determine nature and origin of any 1 curse, including the name of
the one who bequeathed it.
@@ 11
As Light Lore I, except caster can ascertain the origin point and nature of
any 1 item “of darkness” or “of evil”.
@@ 12
As Light Lore I, except that caster can ascertain the origin point and nature
of any 2 “holy items” or caster can determine the nature, origin point, and
the exact significance of any 1 “holy item”.
@@ 15
Caster can determine the nature and origin of extreme emotion(s) found within
any 1 target (inanimate or animate); the degree and other details of the
emotion(s) can also be acquired.
@@ 17
As Light Lore I, except that caster can ascertain the origin point and nature
of any 3 “holy items” or caster can determine the age, origin point, name of
the creator, and nature of any 1 “holy item”. Caster also learns item’s
specific capabilities.
@@ 18
As Light Lore II, except that it can only be used on items “of darkness” or
“of evil”.
@@ 19
Caster can ascertain exact nature, origin, purpose, and history of any 1 “holy
item”; it allows caster to visualize all who have possessed the item.
@@ 20
As Light Lore III, except that it can be used only on items of evil or
“darkness”.
@@ 25
As Life Lore, except caster can determine specific traits and capabilities of
any 1 target.
@@ 30
As White Lore, except it can only be used on an item “of darkness” or “of
evil”.
@@ 50
As White Lore, except caster can acquire the information on all “holy items”
within 100'.
